curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As her world quietly fractures, can any genuine connection survive within the grip of dependency?
curatedMovie.description: In 1970s Berlin, a teen girl’s heroin addiction reshapes her life as she joins a small group and falls in love.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, deliberate, and emotionally sobering. A slow-paced German drama suited for focused solitary viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This drama stays with one teen girl as addiction changes her relationships and the shape of her life.
